scientific_integrity: General proof by p-adic quadratic-root counting, explicit fiber multiplicities, and Chinese remainder theorem. Standalone exact integer enumeration and numeric Fourier checks corroborate only tested finite cases. Literature priority comparison is bounded.
scientific_limitations: Exact full pair-sum convolution on odd modular inverse hyperbolas, with unweighted full two-frequency Fourier fourth moment. Prime-field k=1 case is known; new classification targets repeated-prime factors. No even-modulus, arbitrary-coefficient sharp extension, or independent verification theorem is claimed.
title: Complete pair-sum spectrum and fourth Kloosterman moments of odd modular hyperbolas
